::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 8th [1862]  
**From:** Baldersby  
**Manuscript:** MS Reading University Library, uncatalogued Bell MSS/1
:::

[Gentlemen](organizations/other_135.qmd),
I am greatly obliged for the copies of [Mrs](people/person_549.qmd) & [Miss Gatty](people/person_494.qmd)’s Books. I find that my not having sooner received the former ones was owing to my directions for the forwarding of parcels to me me [sic] not having been attended to. I am sorry that I have thus been the innocent cause of so much inconvenience and of having thus received more than my due of copies.

yours faithfully
C M Yonge
